Exposure tags (one per alert; the priority banner must match the tag's priority):

Renamed exposure tags: Content - Negative discussion of owned content / Content - Threshold met for negativity on owned post -> Content - Negative reaction to owned social post; *NEW* Employees - Misconduct allegations / NEW Employees - Misconduct allegations -> Employees - Misconduct allegations; Product - Dangerous/offensive results -> Product - Dangerous results (e.g. medical/legal); Product - Litigation / [ARCH] Product - Litigation -> Brand - Litigation; Employees - Criticism of Exec Statements -> Employees - Executive criticism; Product - Factual inaccuracies (not dangerous/offensive) 2 -> Product - Factual inaccuracies (not dangerous/offensive); Brand - Other brand issues / Brand - General criticism of Google brand / Brand – General criticism of Google brand -> Brand - Other/general criticism; Brand - Community Investment -> Brand - Social & Economic Impact; Brand - Value Earnings & Finance -> Brand - Value & Earnings; Product - Memes & humorous content -> Product - Meme about Google products; Product - Other product issues / Product - General criticism -> Product - Other/general criticism; Product - Product failures - general hardware issues/product damage -> Product - Product failures - general hardware issues

Product names: Ads/Merchant Center, AI Mode, AI Overviews, Android (Android OS & Google TV), Antigravity, Assistant/Home, Brand, Executives, Calendar, Chrome, Chromebook, Googlebook, Chromecast, Cloud, Cloud x Gemini (incl. Android Studio), Data Centers, DeepMind, Devs Products, Doodles, Easter Eggs and Delight Features, Google for Education, Fitbit, Google One (G1), Gemini App, Gemini Model, Nano Banana, GFiber, Glass, Google Health, Google News, Google Research, Grow with Google, Intrinsic.ai, Isomorphic Labs, Jigsaw, Kaggle, Labs (e.g. ImageFX), Lyria, Lens, Maps/Geo, NotebookLM, Pay, Photos, Pixel, Play Store, Reviews, Search, Search Images, Search Knowledge Panel, Shopping, Translate, Trends, Veo, Waymo, Waze, Wing, Workspace, Willow, YouTube
Products no longer used: Employees -> Brand; Central AI -> Gemini Model or Gemini App or DeepMind or Devs Products or Brand; Gems -> Gemini App
Engagement levels: VERY LOW from 0, LOW from 200, MODERATE from 500, HIGH from 2,000; a KOF author's alert shows the level for its count (or VIRAL KOF).

KOF (Key Opinion Former): the KOF or influencer list(s) the author is on, as Burson's tools show them (for example "Viral KOFs (KOFs)" or "CAM Tech/AI (INFs)"), or No. An author on any of those lists counts as a KOF, whatever the engagement or follower count.

Social Network must match the link: X (x.com, twitter.com); Reddit (reddit.com, redd.it); Bluesky (bsky.app); Threads (threads.net, threads.com); TikTok (tiktok.com); Instagram (instagram.com); Facebook (facebook.com, fb.com, fb.watch); YouTube (youtube.com, youtu.be); LinkedIn (linkedin.com); Truth Social (truthsocial.com); Gab (gab.com); Rumble (rumble.com)
Issue status: "New / not previously reported over the past 14 days" unless the same issue was reported in the last 14 days, then "Ongoing Issue".

Summary & formatting: 1-2 neutral sentences attributing claims to the author, including follower count when 5,000+ and video timestamp [MM:SS] when relevant. [Name] is "<Issue Name> / <Issue Status>" and [Code] is "<Exposure Tag>,<Engagements>,<Author>,<Sensitive Topic or ->,<Product>,<Issue Status>".

Escalation thresholds (when an alert gets a Social Alert email): URGENT at any engagement (from 0) for a new issue with a P0 exposure tag, a Sensitive Topic, a briefed topic or a KOF author; HIGH ENGAGEMENT at 2,000+ engagements for any other issue (a P1 or P2 exposure tag with no Sensitive Topic and no KOF author). Engagements are likes + comments + shares; views don't count.

Escalation thresholds, ongoing issues: when the same issue was already alerted in the last 14 days, it is escalated again only for a KOF author or at 2,000+ engagements (as an update on the earlier email), except these exposure tags, escalated whatever the issue status: Content - Negative reaction to Google influencer post/activity; Content - Negative reaction to Google site content; Content - Negative reaction to owned social post; Content - Negative reaction to paid Google ad.

Escalation thresholds, Sensitive Topics: Politics counts only for a US (or unknown) location or an English-language mention of an election; a topic that only restates the exposure tag (for example Privacy on "Brand - Privacy & security concerns") doesn't make an alert urgent.

Escalation thresholds, owned social posts: only escalate when the Google-owned social post has reached the threshold of 30+ comments with >=30% negativity (and include the comment count and negativity percentage in the summary).
Trust & Safety (✍️): flagged for scams/phishing, doxxing/PII, self-harm, child safety, graphic violence, hate speech, Gemini hallucinations on sensitive topics, or viral KOF posts.

Emoji reactions on alerts: 👍 = received; ⬇️ = addressed on updated post below; 📦 = escalation email sent; ✍️ = Trust & Safety form submitted; ❌ = reviewed, no escalation needed; group emojis (📰 💬 💼 💧 1️⃣ 🦺 ⛑️ 🌎 ⚖️ 🌱 📸) = stakeholder groups included in the escalation.
